The Legends Awaken! (Part 1)''' (Japanese: '''ソード＆シールド「最強の剣と盾」①''' ''Sword & Shield - The Ultimate Sword and Shield 1'') is the thirteenth chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the {{pkmn|animated series}} episodes ''[[JN042|Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald!]]'' and ''[[JN043|Sword and Shield: The Darkest Day!]]''. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] encounter {{p|Zacian}} and {{p|Zamazenta}}, respectively, for the first time. * Ash meets {{an|Leon}} again and joins him in stopping rampaging [[Dynamax]] Pokémon. * Goh meets [[Sonia]] and helps her investigate the [[Darkest Day]]. * Ash meets [[Rose]] and [[Oleana]] for the first time. * [[Oleana's subordinate]]'s [[Gigantamax]] {{p|Garbodor}} destroys the mural at [[Stow-on-Side]], revealing statues of Zacian and Zamazenta behind it. ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Dragapult}} * {{p|Centiskorch}} ([[Gigantamax]]) * {{p|Garbodor}} ([[Gigantamax]]) * {{p|Coalossal}} ([[Gigantamax]]) * {{p|Dreepy}} * {{p|Zacian}} ({{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zacian and Zamazenta|Hero of Many Battles}}) * {{p|Zamazenta}} ({{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zacian and Zamazenta|Hero of Many Battles}}) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Ash}} * [[Goh]] * {{an|Leon}} * [[Rose]] * [[Sonia]] * [[Oleana]] * [[Doug and Eva]] * {{tc|Macro Cosmos's|Macro Cosmos employees}} ** [[Oleana's subordinate]] * Townspeople ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}) * {{p|Dragonite}} ({{OP|Ash|Dragonite}}) * {{p|Raboot}} ({{OP|Goh|Raboot}}) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Professor Cerise]]'s; Ash doesn't use {{AP|Pikachu}} or {{AP|Riolu}} to battle it. * Ash and {{an|Leon}} do not battle [[Dynamax]] {{p|Pangoro}}. * {{TRT}} and [[Professor Magnolia]]'s appearances are omitted. * Goh and [[Sonia]] never visit [[Turffield]] or [[Wedgehurst]]. Goh never obtains a [[Dynamax Band]]. * Ash doesn't use {{AP|Gengar}} against Gigantamax {{p|Coalossal}}. * Ash never has dinner with [[Rose]] and [[Oleana]] at [[Rose Tower]]. Rose's offer is instead made during their first encounter. * {{TP|Goh|Raboot}} never uses Dynamax.
